vajezatha_2935.name: Vajezatha
bio: Purity; worthy of honour, one of Haman’s sons, whom the Jews slew in the palace of Shushan ([Esther 9:9](/esth#Esth.9.9)).

vashti_2937.name: Vashti
bio: Beautiful, the queen of Ahasuerus, who was deposed from her royal dignity because she refused to obey the king when he desired her to appear in the banqueting hall of Shushan the palace ([Esther 1:10-12](/esth#Esth.1.10)).
